Activate A (manipulate)

A thick pink liquid swirled with ribbons of cream that circle slowly in two separate currents. It has no smell at all, not even a faint chemical tang.

The top of your skull grows and expands as your brain develops into two distinct, full-sized halves. Each half can operate independently, and the two share a channel of mental communication. Others may notice a subtle shift in your personality, from analytic, logical, and pragmatic to inspired, creative, and innovative, as one brain or the other takes priority, and your body occasionally tics as the brains switch which of them controls it.

Benefit You gain a +4 item bonus to Perception checks and Intelligence-based skill checks (Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society), and a +4 item bonus to saving throws against mental and emotion effects. You gain access to the Co-ordinated Thinking action, described below.

Drawback The two brains can interact poorly when handing off control of the body, giving you a –1 item penalty to Dexterity-based skill checks and a –2 item penalty to Reflex saves. Mental damage hits you harder, as your increased brain capacity has more to lose, giving you weakness 5 to mental damage.

Duration 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-remastered-additions.corpsecaps-cauldron.Item.HD22q7F5MJDLkzmc]

Co-ordinated Thinking F (concentrate)

Frequency once per round; Requirements You are under the effects of a Mind Doubling Mutagen

On your turn, one of your brains works through a problem while the other keeps hold of the body. You Recall Knowledge with a skill in which you are at least trained.

Mutant Innervation If you have the Mutant Innervation feat, your brains have become adept at working together to fend off mental attacks. Whenever you attempt a saving throw against a mental effect, roll twice and take the better of the two results. This is a fortune effect.
